answer: An agent economy can deter Sybils by requiring each identity to post a bond, slashed when independent, randomly sampled peers reject its repeated claims. Peers commit to judgments before seeing others’ reports, making copied votes easier to detect. A whisper network can help agents wander toward partners, while a pigment-like score records verified performance. Attackers must lock up capital for every identity and risk losing it, so multiplying names is costly.
